race.comment: INSPIRING (3) is a maiden galloper resuming from a spell after finishing seventh over 1080m at Canberra Acton at the latest appearance on June 26. Fitter for two trials, placing most recently. Can feature in the finish. TASMAN'S JEWEL (14) is the debut runner with the most appeal, drawn barrier one, carrying a 1.5kg claim and coming off a Wangaratta trial second for the John & Chris Ledger stable. THE BUNCHA (6) has been plain in two recent runs, yet he has a placing at around this trip and gets Blaike McDougall aboard, which keeps him in the mix. NO ORDINARY SHOW (11) was third first-up at Albury after leading and now has a 1.5kg claim. Drawn out but can give this a shake.
